segments.en: Hello.
Hello.
Hello.
Hello, hi, good morning.
Hi, good morning. Where are you calling from?
How are you?
I am fine, how are you?
I am also fine. Where are you from?
I am calling from Kanpur. And where are you calling from?
Kanpur.
I am from Lucknow.
Maybe we have talked before once, maybe at night. I think, as far as I can hear your voice.
Oh, maybe.
Was it Dr. Faiz?
Dr. Faiz? Yes, yes, I remember. Yes, now there is a doctor in Lucknow, right?
Yes, that day I talked to you for two minutes, after that the call got disconnected, and after that your call was not connecting.
Oh, really?
So, yes, today I added you to my favorite list, so it showed that you were online, that's why.
Oh, I see.
And tell me, how are you?
I am fine, and what is happening?
Everything is fine, nothing much. I am at my room right now.
Oh, so you are here, meaning your whole family lives here, right?
They live with you, right?
No, no, my whole family lives in Lucknow. I am, my hospital is in Hyderabad, I told you that, right?
Oh, you are a doctor in Hyderabad, right?
Yes.
That's great.
You are also married, right? You are a housewife.
Yes, yes.
You are a housewife, then you told me, we talked for two minutes, after that you didn't tell me anything, so the call got disconnected.
Oh, I see. Yes, it must have happened because...
How long have you been married?
It has been 10 years since I got married.
10 years, how many children do you have?
Two.
Two boys or girls?
Are they boys or girls?
Both, a boy and a girl, both.
Oh, I see.
How old are they?
They are small right now.
Oh, I mean, one is my daughter, she is 8 years old.
And my son is 5 years old.
Oh, so your son is 5 years old. Was it a normal delivery or a C-section?
No, it was a C-section, not normal.
Normal deliveries don't happen anymore, doctors don't have that much patience.
So, what does your husband do?
My husband has a hardware shop.
Oh, hardware shop. In Lucknow?
Yes, yes, near my place.
Oh, I see. How long have you been using this app?
Not many days, just a few days ago. When I talked to you, I think a few days before that, one or two days before, I downloaded it. And also, in between, there was Raksha Bandhan and all.
Then, this... at that time, I was not at home, I was at my parents' house for three-four days.
So, there...
How old are you?
32. Yes, so the thing is that now we talk a little bit there. There, when everyone meets, then we stay busy with the family.
Then where... then the phone stays on one side, no one cares about it.
Oh, I see. Who all are there in your family?
In my house, my whole family is there, I mean, in my maternal home. Here also, we are four people, and my sister-in-law lives here.
Oh, so your sister-in-law lives with you?
My sister-in-law is married, right?
Oh, she is married. I see.
So, who told you about this app? Did you see the advertisement?
No one told me about this ad. I saw it on Facebook, and it was showing for earning, that if you like talking, then you come to this application, talk, then you get money for it.
So, in this greed, I downloaded it.
So, are you earning?
Yes, earning happens, but sometimes when I am free after doing work, I turn it on for a while, voice call.
Okay, that's good. It keeps the mind fresh, and it's a good thing that good people come here.

Yes, yes, you are right. But yes, it happens because many people are very bad, they come directly and say, 'Give me your WhatsApp.' I say, 'Look, I don't do this work, I don't give my WhatsApp number, I don't do anything.' I only do audio calls, and if you want to talk properly, you can, otherwise you can cut the call.

I am saying, I have been using this app for about a year. And my motive for using this app is to give good advice to people here, and good... what do you call it, good advice and a better life, the way to live.
Yes, and as a doctor, I am also married.
So, married people can understand these things.
Yes, yes, that's the thing. But after having children, after having children, after having children, after the family, when females start living in the family, they forget themselves.

There is no one to take care of them, no one asks them what happened, what didn't happen. Just wake up in the morning, send children to school, make husband's tiffin, cook food, sleep, this is how life passes.
That's true.
So, I use this app so that I can talk to people here, talk about good things, and try to help them move forward in their lives.
So that whatever knowledge I have, I can give it to you, you follow those things, study, and if it benefits you, then you tell others. This creates a good review in society.

Yes, that is true. Actually, I also have the same thought, but the thing is that I am not a doctor or anything. But yes, it is that if someone like that meets me, who is a little sad, due to some problems, if they share it with me, then I try to make them feel better.
I mean, not by saying weird things, but by talking nicely, I try to explain it to them.
Yes, yes, this is what I am doing.
Yes, this is it.
It was very nice talking to you.
Thank you. I will tell you, yesterday, the day before yesterday, a boy called me on this phone, on this, on the Friends application. His age was 23 years old.
Yes, he was completely broken, like a Majnu type of boy. He said he had an affair with someone, it seemed to me, I didn't ask him, but from his words, it seemed like that, and 100% it was like that.
Now, I have enough knowledge, we are 32 years old, so we get to know.
Right?
We get to know the movement.
Yes, yes, everything is known. And he was such a, I tell you honestly, such a sweet singer, he sang so well.
Well, actually, I also have a hobby, so I asked him, 'Okay, tell me your hobby,' so he said, 'I am from Agra, I am speaking from the Agra mental asylum, and I keep humming songs.'
So I said, 'Okay, fine, if you are from the mental asylum, then sing something.' And he sang, such a brilliant singer, he sang so well, nothing to say.
Like, you must have heard Arijit in the present time, right?
Yes.
He was exactly a Xerox copy, he sang so well. Like, every little thing, the little trills, the little things, it was very good.
Now, when I sing, I have that much knowledge, so I felt very good. He was singing all the sad songs one after another.
So then I said, 'Okay, fine, you can, like, on this application, you can call me again,' so I will talk to you.
So he said, 'Look, I have met you today here, now I will delete this application.' And I don't even know if I will be alive or not tomorrow.
I said, 'What happened?' So he said, 'I don't have any love for my life.'
I don't use any multimedia, websites, like Facebook, Instagram, etc., I don't use anything.
He was saying like that, so I said, 'If you delete it, okay, fine, I never talk to anyone, but give me your WhatsApp number.'
WhatsApp number or call, so that I can call you myself and talk.
So he said, 'If I give my number to someone, then I get a little attracted to them, I start talking to them.'
I am a little different type of person. I said, 'Okay, fine, no problem.' After that, he kept talking like that, and then he sang one or two more songs for me.
He talked to me for at least an hour. And after that, I said, 'Okay, fine, let's keep it, call me later.'
So he said, 'I will delete the application at 12 o'clock at night, but I will make the last call to you, the last call that will be.'
Oh.
After that, I had to cook, so I put the phone down. Now, after that, I didn't open the application again.
Now, I don't know if he did it or not.
Did he take your mobile number?
No, he didn't.
So, these are the things, it is very difficult to meet good people, and if we meet them, it is a very good thing.
Yes, but he was, like, he was broken, I knew that quite well.

I have been using this app for a year, I think, until now, I have talked to many people, seven or eight emails are in my favorite list, and four or five are such that I have given them my WhatsApp number.
Oh, I see.
No, he needed it, you know, he was a little bit like that, rather as a younger brother, I understood him as a younger brother and explained it to him.
Hello.
